charolais.definition: n. large white or cream-colored breed from France

charon.definition: n. (Greek mythology) the ferryman who brought the souls of the dead across the river Styx or the river Acheron to Hades
charon.translation:
n. 在Styx河上渡亡往冥府去的神
a. 摆渡的

charophyceae.definition: n. in some classifications: contains only the order Charales
